description: This PHP source file defines a class 'DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator' which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items within the OrangeHRM Time module, specifically for setting up the display of a project report criteria screen.

classes.name: DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu options related to detailed project activity reports within the Time module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the provided Screen object by overriding it with 'displayProjectReportCriteria'.
